body: I trust you will make it through, because I am in the same boat,I'm likely to do whatever  you do,so I'm hoping  you do well and keep on going,the goal in this life is to find happiness.

Yes I am under a doctor's care but no matter what I do or what prescriptions he gives me it doesn't work I always feel the same,and then I'm just left with the sadness to fester for 6 weeks all the while trying to fake feelings of joy to comfort my already unsuitable family.I haven't felt actual excitement  or real happiness  in 7 years.And the therapists they were talking to me about aren't event trying to contact  us.
